# New World pantheons - deities for auto-generated New World religions
# Created to provide valid pantheons (fixes 'No valid pantheon' errors). Structure mirrors 00_sun_religion.txt.

deity_drakhya_flame_war = {
	trigger = {
		polytheistic_check_religion_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			common_deity_trigger = {
				RELIGION = drakhya_flame
			}
		}
	}
	icon = deity_war
	passive_modifier = { war_score_cost = deity_war_score_cost_svalue }
	omen = { land_morale_modifier = omen_land_morale_modifier_svalue } #Bonus from Omen
	religion = drakhya_flame
	deity_category = war

	deification_trigger = {
		can_deify_trigger = yes
	}

	on_activate = {
		military_apotheosis_military_experience_effect = yes
	}
}
